name: terminal-screenshot
description: >- MUST be used right after changing any CLI color config (delta/bat/themes/lazygit pager) — renders the terminal's colored output to a PNG so Claude can actually SEE contrast, alignment, and highlighting instead of raw ANSI codes. Use for delta git diff colors, bat syntax highlighting, starship prompt, eza/ls colors, or ripgrep matches. Trigger phrases: 看终端效果, 终端截图, 验证配色, terminal screenshot.
author: daymade
